description:
Read raw RS3 guide-price observations. Use summarize_price_history for calculated trends or get_item_details for item records.

source=jagex (default) offers roughly 180 days with provider averages; weirdgloop offers roughly 90 days with daily volume. Neither supplies live offers.

itemId skips name resolution; ambiguity returns candidates. from/to select inclusive UTC days: equal bounds cover the whole day but cannot extend provider retention.

Invalid bounds fail before lookup. Unavailable dates yield empty data; provider errors never fall back. Each call reads one history endpoint.

No credentials or cache. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; honor 429 Retry-After.

from.description: First UTC date to include; omitted means start of available history

itemId.description: Grand Exchange item ID (provide itemId or name)

source.description: Provider/shape: Jagex daily+average maps (default), or raw Weirdgloop daily samples

to.description: Last UTC date to include; omitted means end of available history

name: get_price_series

average.description: Jagex averaged guide prices in coins, keyed by Unix timestamp in milliseconds

daily.description: Daily guide prices in coins, keyed by Unix timestamp in milliseconds

samples.description: Chronological usable observations; malformed timestamp/price rows are discarded, unreported volume omitted, and an entirely malformed nonempty feed is an error

timestamp.description: UTC Unix timestamp in milliseconds, not seconds

source.description: Present for the Weirdgloop sample-array variant

title: Get Item Price Time Series
